subject: Pricing & commit sizing — Redwood evaluation
messages:
From: Aya Patel <aya.patel@datuminsight.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-12T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing & commit sizing — Redwood evaluation

Jonas / Neha,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Datum Insight is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the private deployment options. The procurement and finance teams are working through internal timing, but we need a clearer picture on the economics to firm up a Q4 commit. Specifically:

- Example commit size you're seeing for customers with heavy embedding + chat usage (we're targeting ~300M tokens/month at peak).
- Standard discounting for a 12-month committed ARR (ballpark %).
- Any pilot credits or POC support you can commit to while we run evaluation tests.
- A mutual action/close plan with milestones and owner names (we have a security review, SOC evidence, and a final procurement approval).

I've attached our RFP excerpt to make weighting explicit. Can you share a MAP and provisional pricing today or early next week? We have a vendor selection meeting on 9/20.

Appreciate it — Aya

--
Aya Patel
Head of Platform Partnerships
Datum Insight
aya.patel@datuminsight.com
[attachment: Datum_RFP_Q3.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Aya Patel <aya.patel@datuminsight.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-13T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & commit sizing — Redwood evaluation

Hi Aya — thanks for the clear ask and the RFP. We're excited to move forward. High level response below and a proposed MAP attached.

Summary (provisional):
- Typical commit sizing for similar usage: $400k–$750k ACV (depends on token mix, embeddings vs. chat). For your target ~300M tokens/month at peak, initial conservative commit recommendation: $500k ACV with staged increases after POC.
- Discount: we can propose a 15–20% volume discount at $500k commit level; exact number requires finance approval.
- Pilot credits: propose $20k in platform credits + dedicated engineer hours during the POC window.

Attached is a first-pass MAP (milestones, owners, timing) and a short pricing_summary. Key next steps I propose:
1) We run the POC (2 weeks) — security gate and SOC evidence concurrent. Owner: Neha (SE + CS).
2) Procurement review & legal redline (week-of 9/20) — Owner: Aya + Datum procurement.
3) Commit review & finance approval (target 9/24) — Owners: Ben (Redwood finance liaison) / Datum finance.

If this aligns, I'll ask Ben to provisionally approve a discount band and coordinate finance sign-off. Ready to hop on a 30-min call if that helps.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, pricing_summary.pdf

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

I can run the POC scheduling and own the SOC evidence collection.

-Neha

Neha / Jonas — provisional OK from my side for the external messaging: 20% discount at $500k ACV + $20k pilot credit, contingent on finance sign-off. Notes for finance:
- Revenue recognition: annual prepay preferred but we can support quarterly billing with commitment language.
- Credit accounting: apply to first 60 days of usage during POC; any unused credit expires at the end of the POC period.
- Requires approval from Finance (Claire Johnson) for sign-off by 9/23. I'm looping Claire separately.

Jonas — please push updated MAP and a short term sheet reflecting the provisional numbers to Aya. Neha will coordinate POC schedule and security artifacts.

-ben
